newsitem.title: USA: WorldCom Inc sets $2.0 bln debt deal.
newsitem.headline: WorldCom Inc sets $2.0 bln debt deal.

text.p: The following issue from WorldCom Inc was priced on Wednesday, according to lead manager Salomon Brothers Inc.
The deal was upped in size to $2.0 billion from an initial $1.5 billion to meet investor demand.
WorldCom Inc, based in Jackson, Miss., provides local, long distance, international and internet telephone services to customers.
BORROWER WORLDCOM INC

*THE ISSUE IS PUTABLE IN THE 12TH YEAR
Proceeds from the offering will be used primarily for the repayment of bank debt, general corporate purposes and to fund expansion, the company said.
